result_text:
I made two changes that should fix the missing shop, but I haven't run either one. There's no Rojo or Studio check here, so please playtest them. I also didn't confirm which of the two was your actual problem.

1. **Wave never ending (`src/server/Zombies.server.lua`).** The wave loop opens the shop only once `alive` reaches 0, and that count only dropped when a zombie's `Died` event fired. A zombie removed some other way never decremented it. Falling out of the world is the likely case. The wave then hung and `Shop.open()` was never called. Each zombie now also stops counting as alive when it's destroyed, and the count can't go down twice for the same zombie.

2. **Cards not showing (`src/client/ShopUi.client.lua`).** The card widths came from `cards.AbsoluteSize.X`. That can still be 0 on the first render right after the GUI is enabled, which would give you an empty panel. The widths are now scale-based, so they don't depend on layout timing.

If the shop still doesn't show, tell me whether the "Upgrade Shop" panel appears at all when a wave is cleared. That will show whether the problem is the server never opening it or the client not drawing it.
